title: INSIGHT: a scalable isothermal NASBA-based platform for COVID-19 diagnosis
author: Qianxin Wu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bghsjt6e

steps.title: Lyse saliva samples
steps.instruction: Mix crude saliva with QuickExtract DNA Extraction Solution at a 1:1 volume ratio and incubate the mixture at 95 °C for 5 minutes to lyse virus particles and inactivate proteinase K.

steps.title: Set up NASBA reaction
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 µL of the lysate from Step 1 into a NASBA reaction mixture (prepared in‑house or from the Life Sciences NASBA liquid kit) and bring the total reaction volume to 20 µL.

steps.title: Detect RNA with lateral flow (0.5 µM Bio‑11‑UTP)
steps.instruction: Add Bio‑11‑UTP to the NASBA nucleotide mix to a final concentration of 0.5 µM, run the NASBA reaction, then purify the RNA using the Direct‑zol RNA Miniprep kit and elute in 30 µL RNase‑free water. Mix 4.2 µL of purified RNA with 1.8 µL FAM‑labelled RNA capture oligo and 84 µL PCRD extraction buffer; transfer 75 µL of this mixture to the sample well of a PCRD test cassette and read the result within 10 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add Bio‑11‑UTP (0.5 µM) to NASBA mix before amplification.
After NASBA, purify RNA with Direct‑zol kit, elute in 30 µL RNase‑free water.
Combine 4.2 µL RNA, 1.8 µL FAM‑capture oligo, 84 µL PCRD buffer.
Apply 75 µL to PCRD cassette well; result appears in ≤10 min.

steps.title: Prepare barcoded NASBA library
steps.instruction: Design forward and reverse primers that each carry a unique barcode sequence upstream of the primer binding site; prepend an Illumina sequencing adaptor upstream of the forward‑primer barcode to serve as a universal PCR handle. After NASBA, pool the uniquely barcoded end‑products from all samples and purify them. Perform a one‑step PCR using universal P5 and P7 primers; optionally add a second layer of indexing barcodes for higher multiplexing.

substeps.instruction: Add barcode sequences to forward and reverse primers.
Add Illumina adaptor upstream of forward‑primer barcode.
Pool and purify barcoded NASBA products.
Run one‑step PCR with universal P5/P7 primers.

steps.title: Detect RNA with lateral flow (0.5 mM Bio‑11‑UTP)
steps.instruction: Add Bio‑11‑UTP to the NASBA nucleotide mixture to a final concentration of 0.5 mM, complete the NASBA reaction, purify RNA with the Direct‑zol RNA Miniprep kit (elute in 30 µL RNase‑free water), then mix 4.2 µL purified RNA, 1.8 µL FAM‑labelled capture oligo and 84 µL PCRD extraction buffer. Transfer 75 µL of this mixture to a PCRD test cassette well and read the result within 10 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add Bio‑11‑UTP (0.5 mM) to NASBA mix before amplification.
Purify RNA post‑NASBA, elute in 30 µL RNase‑free water.
Combine 4.2 µL RNA, 1.8 µL FAM‑capture oligo, 84 µL PCRD buffer.
Apply 75 µL to PCRD cassette; result appears in ≤10 min.

steps.title: Prepare barcoded NASBA products
steps.instruction: Add barcode sequences upstream of each forward and reverse primer and prepend an Illumina sequencing adaptor upstream of the forward‑primer barcode. Pool and purify the uniquely barcoded NASBA end‑products, then perform a one‑step PCR with universal P5 and P7 primers; an additional layer of indexing barcodes may be added if further multiplexing is required.

substeps.instruction: Incorporate barcodes into forward and reverse primers.
Add Illumina adaptor upstream of forward‑primer barcode.
Pool and purify barcoded NASBA products.
Execute one‑step PCR using universal P5/P7 primers.
